role: AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
summary: Google is hiring for a hybrid technical-strategic role that bridges the gap between initial AI sales agreements and successful technical implementation. The core of the job involves architecting enterprise-grade AI solutions while actively debugging code and managing the delivery lifecycle within complex customer IT ecosystems. A strong candidate separates themselves by demonstrating the ability to translate deep technical integration hurdles into clear business impact while influencing both executive stakeholders and core engineering teams. Sample questions are generated practice prompts, not taken from a Google source.

requirements.text: AI platform integration
requirements.meaning: This role requires connecting frontier models and orchestration frameworks like LangGraph into existing enterprise data and identity systems using the Vertex AI platform.
sample_questions: How would you integrate a Gemini-based agent using LangGraph into a customer's legacy enterprise content management system?
Describe your process for deploying an AI/ML model into a production environment with strict data residency requirements.
A customer wants to use Vertex AI but has a complex on-premise identity provider; how do you architect the secure connection?
What are the most common failure points you've seen when integrating LLMs into existing enterprise data pipelines?
requirements.listen_for: The interviewer is looking for specific experience with orchestration frameworks and a deep understanding of how AI assets interact with enterprise security and data boundaries.
